describe_availability_zones: build a python module to list all AWS EC2 availability zone names in a given region
describe_vpc_peering_connections: build a python module to describe VPC peering connections filtered by accepter VPC ID
accept_vpc_peering_connection: build a python module to accept a pending VPC peering connection by its connection ID
create_route: build a python module to create a new route in a route table using a VPC peering connection
replace_route: build a python module to replace an existing route in a route table with a VPC peering connection target
